subject: Energy
title: Short vs Long Duration Storage
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Short vs Long Duration Storage.

hook.text: Short-duration storage (2–4 hours) handles daily peaks—long-duration (days to weeks) covers extended weather events.

buildup.text: Lithium-ion batteries dominate short-duration—they charge from midday solar and discharge through the evening peak.

discovery.text: Long-duration storage covers 'dunkelflaute'—German for dark doldrums, when clouds and calm persist for days.

twist.text: Long-duration tech is far less mature—hydrogen, iron-air batteries, and compressed air are still early-stage.

climax.text: A 100% renewable grid may need weeks of energy reserves—a challenge no existing battery technology can affordably meet.

punchline.text: Hours or weeks—different timescales need different tech.
